name: Greeny Blue
lede: Greeny Blue is a muted sea green named by modifier grammar as greeny plus [[blue]], recorded by the 2010 xkcd color survey.

sections.title: Greeny, plus blue
sections.body:
Our data classes Greeny Blue as a descriptive-modifier name, pairing the informal adjective "greeny" with the parent color [[blue]] [1]. The spelling "greeny" rather than "greenish" is the kind of casual variant the xkcd survey's free-text entry invited, and our sources give no history for this exact value beyond that 2010 crowd-sourced list [1].

The nearest named look-alikes on file are [[jungle-green|Jungle Green]], almost the same shade, and [[zomp|Zomp]], a darker variant [2]. [[mountain-meadow|Mountain Meadow]] and [[keppel|Keppel]] sit further off, both more vivid [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: In our 23,781-painting archive, 6 paintings carry a color close enough to this one over enough of their canvas to count, about 0.03 per cent, as photographed, rarer than 82 per cent of our named colors [3]. The sample is too small to support any claim about painters, periods or countries, and these are photographs of aged, varnished paintings read as screen colors, not pigment matches [3].
